shared_elements: human or humanoid figure depicted frontally/in profile with garment detail
incised low-relief carving on a flat stone face
depiction of held or worn objects (staff/weapon, jewellery, vessel)
justification: Both surfaces show human/humanoid figures carved in low relief with garment or ornament detail, and both include curved motifs and a band-like horizontal division, but these are generic. A shows a single massive frontal figure with a huge blocky head, schematic incised symbols (a large ring/disc, crescents) across a body-shaped block, while B shows a procession of several slender profile figures in patterned robes with elaborate hairstyles, holding objects and standing in ordered registers — quite different conventions of proportion and composition.
